input_files.comment: The Painting Weekly Plan workbook(s) dropped into paths.upload_folder - one 'Spool List' sheet per file, one row per spool. The filename itself varies run to run (e.g. 'Painting Weekly Plan-2-Sep-26.xlsx') - only the substring 'Painting Weekly Plan' is stable, per the project owner - hence the wildcard file_pattern below rather than an exact name. Cross-referenced against the Fabrication (DPR) workbook's RFP-done spools (config/settings.json -> input_files.fabrication, read via src/reader.py -> ExcelReader().read_fabrication(), same as every other department) - see src/painting/reader.py -> read_dpr_rfp_spools().

publishing.comment: When true, every run also copies the painting bundle into paths.website_data_folder - the file website/painting.html auto-loads for every visitor, same pattern as config/packing_settings.json.
